description:
ServiceNow Developer, Junior The Opportunity: 
 Join Booz Allen Hamilton’s internal IT organization as an entry-level ServiceNow Developer and help shape the technology and digital experiences that enable our employees and business operations. As part of a collaborative technology team, you will contribute to the development, enhancement, and support of Booz Allen’s ServiceNow platform, helping transform business processes, streamline workflows, and deliver innovative solutions to internal stakeholders.
  
 In this role, you will apply foundational programming, scripting, and problem-solving skills gained through your academic coursework to develop practical technology solutions. Working alongside experienced developers, platform administrators, architects, and business partners, you will gain hands-on experience designing, developing, testing, and enhancing ServiceNow applications and platform capabilities.
 You will help translate business needs into effective technical solutions, build and refine application logic, automate manual processes, improve the employee experience, and support the security, reliability, and performance of the platform. You will also learn how to leverage ServiceNow’s native capabilities and development best practices to deliver scalable, maintainable solutions that maximize the value of the platform and its return on investment.
  
 Booz Allen offers an opportunity to grow your technical expertise while contributing to technology that supports the company’s internal operations. Through hands-on development, collaboration, and continuous learning, you will build a strong foundation in enterprise application development, workflow automation, platform engineering, and the ServiceNow ecosystem. Due to the nature of work performed within this facility, U.S. citizenship is required.
  
 Join us. The world can't wait.
   
 You Have: 
 Experience a programming or scripting language through in academic environments, such as JavaScript, Python, Java, or C#
 Knowledge of programming concepts gained through academic coursework, including variables, data types, conditional logic, loops, functions, and object-oriented programming
 Knowledge of databases, relational data, SQL, and how applications interact with and manipulate data
 Ability to analyze technical problems, develop logical solutions, troubleshoot issues, and apply structured thinking
 Ability to learn new technologies, development frameworks, and enterprise platforms
 Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly, collaborate with team members, and contribute effectively in a team environment
 Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a technology field
   
 Nice If You Have: 
 Experience with project management, change management, process improvement, or customer management
 Experience utilizing artificial intelligence such as prompt engineering, and machine learning to address program problems
 Experience with SQL, API, and integrations
 Experience with Agile methodologies
  
 Clearance: 
 Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
 
 Compensation 
 At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.
 
Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $53,000.00 to $108,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date. 
 Identity Statement 
 As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.
 
 Candidate AI Usage Policy 
 AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided . 

 Work Model 
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.
 Remote : If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
 Hybrid : If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
 Onsite : If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.
 
 Commitment to Non-Discrimination 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.
